banner.title: This website uses cookies
banner.body: We use necessary cookies for the site to work and, with your permission, Google Analytics to understand how it's used, remember your preferences and improve it.

settings.title: Cookie preferences
settings.intro: Enable the categories you accept. Necessary cookies cannot be disabled because they're essential for the site to work.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.desc: Essential for the site to work: session, language preferences, security. Cannot be disabled.

preferences.name: Preferences
preferences.desc: Remember choices that improve your experience, such as language or region.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.desc: Google Analytics helps us understand in aggregate how the site is used so we can improve it. Without these cookies we don't know what's working.

marketing.name: Marketing
marketing.desc: To show you relevant content on other platforms. We don't currently use marketing cookies; enabling them here will only take effect if we add any in the future.

settings.moreInfo: More info in our Cookie Policy and Privacy Policy.
